title: Bodega Cat
tagline: A community (of real humans) to find cats and create NFTs of them! Share your local friendly (optional) bodega cat with your community 🐱
description: This project combines decentralized storage both for NFT metadata and images. NFTs are minted both on Rinkeby and testnet Near! Anyone can submit their cat photos and explore what others are up to. All the data is stored in Tableland, so it's very easy to do any relational queries.
how_its_made:
IPFS & Filecoin, Skale: these were great for storing cat pictures as NFT images.
NFTPort: used to mint NFTs on Rinkeby and then later retrieved for display.
Tableland: all metadata and CIDs were stored and later queried to display in the landing page.
Worldcoin: provided a great proof of human verification prior to submissions.
